features.description: A resumed run merges main into the run branch before any session, the initializer included, so an initializer re-run after a no-list end plans from the current spec (E0).
steps: tests/stub-claude.sh: STUB_INIT_LIMIT=1 makes the initializer branch replay tests/fixtures/usage-limit.jsonl and exit 1 (no feature list written)

tests/run.sh has a check named `continue after a no-list end merges main first` that: starts a run with STUB_INIT_LIMIT=1 and sees `$HARNESS_STATE/proj/<run>/ended` start with `usage limit before the feature list`; commits a revised SPEC.md (containing the word `revised`) to $T/proj main and pushes it; runs `harness continue <run> --foreground` without the flag; then asserts `grep -q revised $T/wt/proj/<run>/SPEC.md` and that harness-log.md has `merged main into harness/<run>` on a line before `feature list written`
That check was watched failing before the driver change (the session's entry says so with the FAIL line)

lib/driver.sh: sync_main runs on every resumed run (a run whose $STATE/run.log already holds an earlier `run <id> on` line, or whose feature list exists) before the initializer or any session; the configuration reload after merging main keeps working (the existing check `run 15` still passes)
journal/decisions.md has the E0 entry (the number the plan reserved) with finding · choice · rejected
bash -n lib/driver.sh tests/stub-claude.sh tests/run.sh pass; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing
